title: Vikram and Betal: The Smart Rabbit

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a lion and animals.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about animals living in fear of a lion.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.summary: Animals send one animal each day.
scenes.text: Animals decided to send one animal daily to the lion.
scenes.image_prompt: animals sadly choosing one animal cartoon

scenes.text: The rabbit delayed and told the lion about another lion.
scenes.image_prompt: rabbit talking to angry lion cartoon

scenes.summary: The lion jumps into the well.
scenes.text: The lion saw his reflection and jumped into the well.
The rabbit saved all animals. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.
scenes.image_prompt: rabbit happy while animals celebrate cartoon

story: A clever rabbit tricked a cruel lion by showing his reflection in a well. The lion jumped in and was defeated. Vikram said intelligence is stronger than power.
